name: chronoshield-keeper
description: Minimal TypeScript starter for DreamDEX Event Contracts on Somnia Shannon testnet.

scripts.docs: node -e "import http from 'http'; import fs from 'fs'; import path from 'path'; http.createServer((req, res) => { const file = path.resolve('../../docs/index.html'); fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res); }).listen(8080, () => console.log('ChronoShield Docs running at http://localhost:8080'));"
